system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial ranged proficiency
  • martial shields proficiency

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Sharpshooter counterpart.)

SHARPSHOOTER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000218]{Barrage} 【Max SL 1】

On a ranged attack, spend 10 MP: the attack gains multi (2), or its multi rises by one (max 3).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000219]{Crossfire} 【Max SL 1】

After any visible creature's ranged Accuracy Check: spend (5 + the Result) MP to make the attack miss everyone. Needs a ranged weapon equipped; useless against crits.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000220]{Hawkeye} 【Max SL 5】

Guarding without covering anyone: bank +(SL × 3) damage on your next ranged attack this scene, or take a free bow/firearm attack with High Roll treated as 0.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000221]{Ranged Weapon Mastery} 【Max SL 4】

+(SL) to all Accuracy Checks with ranged weapons.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000222]{Warning Shot} 【Max SL 4】

On a damaging ranged hit, trade all its damage for one option: shaken on each target; slow on each target; or each target loses (SL × 10) MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000223]{Keen Vision} 【Max SL 5】

When a travel roll turns up danger: every other group member gains +(SL) on their next non-offensive Check, or takes (SL × 2) less from the next damage that reaches them.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000224]{The Wanted List} 【Max SL 6】

Rest in a populated area to ask the GM for an open bounty: a target and a condition. Fulfil it before your next rest for (SL × 100) zenit.
